name: inacta-vmodel
description: Phase-aware V-Model engineering method. Eleven skills spanning the Inception, Build, and Run lifecycle: project-context setup, personas, requirements, arc42 architecture, design by contract, test strategy, risk audit, docs viewer, deployment readiness, and an orchestrating workflow. Stack-neutral and runtime-neutral, every skill reads a per-project context file (.vmodel.yml plus docs/project-context.md). This plugin is a thin Claude packaging of the canonical skills in the Inacta skills library.
